agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: contextual adoption posture and conditional decisions

analytical_question: Should the named organization adopt, experiment, monitor, defer or reject machine-learning underwriting support over the next 90 days?
general_et_finding: ML can be evaluated as a predictive support approach, but maturity and diffusion for any specific model cannot be determined from this case. Reliable use requires data and model validation; peer adoption is not proof of local suitability.
application_finding: Underwriting recommendations may reduce review burden, but comparison with existing manual/rules-based practice, fairness testing and explainable adverse-action factors are essential.
organization_specific_finding: The digital bank has established reviewers and secure shadow-mode infrastructure, allowing a reversible, non-customer-impacting evaluation. The missing model outcome data still rules out production deployment.

evidence.claim: Risk management for AI should address governance, context, measurement and management throughout lifecycle.
evidence.notes: Framework informs risk controls; does not establish model maturity or fitness.

evidence.claim: Covered creditors must disclose specific, accurate principal reasons for adverse actions even where complex algorithms are used.
evidence.notes: Relevant to credit decision use; not proof of any specific vendor model performance.

evidence.claim: The organization and capability assumptions are case premises, not independently observed performance results.
evidence.source_or_reference: Assignment 6 instructional scenarios; student-authored test inputs
evidence.notes: Do not treat scenario statements as verified institutional facts.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: No measured accuracy, subgroup error rates, drift, workload savings or third-party model due diligence is supplied.
Peer diffusion and cost superiority over existing practices have not been documented for the specific system.
Existing CFPB guidance is not a substitute for legal assessment of the actual product and current rules.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in safe testability, low confidence in eventual performance without local results. Overall model maturity, vendor evidence and case-specific diffusion remain unknown.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential value is faster and more consistent underwriting support, conditional on demonstrated incremental improvement over the existing review process.
risk_governance_implication: Keep decisions human-controlled; freeze deployment on unexplained subgroup harm, unreliable adverse-action reasons, data leakage or validation failure.
recommendation_management_implication: BOUNDED EXPERIMENT: Conduct a 90-day shadow-mode experiment, cap exposure to nonbinding recommendations, measure accuracy, bias, explainability, operational workload and drift versus the manual baseline; set stop rules and human sign-off. Reject immediate full production adoption as unsupported by local evidence.
change_monitoring_triggers: Independent local model validation and subgroup performance results versus manual baseline
Demonstrated accurate and specific adverse-action reason mapping; compliance sign-off
Measured net benefit, cost and workflow impact; acceptable reversible pilot controls
Approved review after 90 days or sooner upon safety, regulatory or capability changes
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Vendor/model identity, training-data provenance and actual system validation report
Target thresholds approved by model-risk and compliance leadership
Current jurisdiction-specific legal assessment and adverse-action workflow evidence
